title: Made with Claude and Phaser
author: Jamesbob
selftext:
I spent the last few months building Gembound Arena, mostly with Claude Fable and Opus 5. It's a browser-based realtime match-3 PvP game with heroes and abilities.

Play: [https://play.gembound-arena.com](https://play.gembound-arena.com)

Trailer: [https://youtu.be/x4wDiT5tQXY?is=qKpZEaCIy25i3mer](https://youtu.be/x4wDiT5tQXY?is=qKpZEaCIy25i3mer)

Most of the effort went into asset, animation, and character pipelines rather than game code.

Happy to answer questions about the workflow. I'd really value feedback on the game itself as well.

And if anyone has marketing tips for a solo browser game, I'm all ears.

Edit: Fixed link and added trailer

replies.author: Jamesbob
replies.body: Glad you enjoyed it! Let me know if you have any ideas for improvement!
